emily cho: starting mig window for 2.14 -> running MIG_2026_03_21_2. Canary on shard-a then bulk on shard-b.
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] MIG_2026_03_21_2 started on shard-b (job=49102)
diego martinez: observing lock waits on shard-b; median ~1.8s with spikes to 2.4s. watching pg_stat_activity.
olivia tan: recommend soft-throttle first: reduce backfill concurrency and lower batch size. rollback threshold: median >2s for 3m OR error delta >1% sustained -> pause.
emily cho: agreed. apply soft-throttle at 60r/s and keep canary running.
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] soft-throttle applied on shard-b: backfillctl set-rate --shard=b --rate=60 (job=49103)
diego martinez: one long-running worker (pid 90421) holding exclusive lock, contacting owner.
olivia tan: if worker doesn't finish in 45s, terminate and re-evaluate. fallback is full rollback to pinned v2.13 if can't stabilize in 10m.
emily cho: updating release notes and inserting holdpoint in timeline. tagging infra-oncall.
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Next health check scheduled in 5m (1747890135).
